scope: Downstream released-ID replay, not an end-to-end tokenizer reconstruction

original_item_diagnostic.tie_rule: Preserve code rank; expand each code to ascending original item IDs; deduplicate items and truncate to K.

provenance.independent_metric_audit: Recomputed all per-user code/item ranks from predictions and original held-out targets; verified coverage, finite sorted scores, 20 distinct valid codes per user and identical aggregates.
provenance.durability: Selected model and complete per-user predictions verified in the designated private durable store.

limitations: Single training seed; no cross-seed robustness or statistical equivalence claim.
Uses author-trained IDs with incomplete upstream tokenizer-training provenance.
The ordinary-CE control and other datasets are separate cells, not implied by this result.
